description: This file contains tests for voice mapping functions, including XML escaping, voice mapping logic, and voice recognition utilities.

methods.name: escapeXml
methods.description: Escapes XML special characters in a string.

methods.name: mapVoiceToPolly

methods.description: Checks if a given voice name is among the known OpenAI voices.

methods.name: getOpenAiVoiceNames
methods.description: Returns the list of known OpenAI voice names.
